_doc: Farhold bestiary (round 4). `biomes` lists World Forge biome families (worldgen/js/biomes.js BIOME_FAMILIES); `any` means everywhere. `kind` picks the body: `beast` builds an avatar-3d creature from look.creature, `humanoid` builds a Chibi 2 body from look.avatar. `family` is what the thing IS, for affixes that care (undead, construct, fiend...). `role` shapes the AI: skirmisher closes, brute is slow and hard, archer keeps its distance, caster throws spells, leader buffs its pack. `pack` is [min,max] bodies that arrive together. Stats are level-1 values; balance.json enemies.perLevel compounds them per level. SIZES ARE DELIBERATELY LARGE — a creature body at size 1 is roughly its real-world metre size, and a knee-high rat is not a fight, so everything is scaled to read as a threat at eye level. Original names only — no borrowed monsters.
_ranksDoc: Every spawn rolls a rank. `normal` is the table entry as written. `champion` takes one modifier, `rare` takes two and a Name Forge name, `boss` is a hand-written entry from the bosses list. Rank multipliers live in balance.json `ranks`. A modifier may carry `scale` (how much bigger or smaller the body is — actors.js folds it into the rank's own size and grows the reach with it) and `fx`, the name of one of the spell effects' looping status auras, which is how a Fiery one is visibly on fire rather than merely orange in the stat block.

modifiers.name: Unyielding
modifiers.desc: slow, and very hard to put down

modifiers.name: Giant
modifiers.desc: three times the size, and it hits like it

modifiers.name: Fiery
modifiers.desc: burning as it comes, and every hit sets you alight

modifiers.name: Frostbound
modifiers.desc: cased in ice, and it takes the speed out of you

modifiers.name: Stormlash
modifiers.desc: crackling, quick, and it leaves you twitching

modifiers.name: Graveborn
modifiers.desc: it drinks what it deals, and lays a curse doing it

modifiers.name: Bramblehide
modifiers.desc: grown over with thorns that bite whoever hits it

modifiers.name: Hollowed
modifiers.desc: it opens you up, and there is not much left of it to cut

modifiers.name: Wizened
modifiers.desc: small, shrivelled and far too quick

_bossDoc: Bosses are placed, not spawned in the ring: one per dungeon, and one per high zone as a world boss. `arena` is how much room they need cleared around them, in metres. `phases` fire at those fractions of health, each one turning on a modifier and saying a line.

bosses.name: The Warden of the First Hollow

phases.say: Stone grinds — it stops being careful.
She stops waiting for you to come to her.
Coins spill out of it and it does not care.
It starts eating what it takes.
It folds the light away from itself.
It is feeding on the fight.

_petDoc: Pets are the same body builders, driven by js/pets.js instead of the enemy field. `perLevel` scales them off the OWNER's level, not their own.

pets.name: Clockwork Sentry
pets._doc: The tinker's sentry. It used to be a golem body, which stood there like a statue and read as a lamp post with a grudge; it is a three-wheeled rolling turret now so it can actually follow you about. `speed` and `reach` went up to match — it is a vehicle, not a walker.

pets.name: Sellsword
pets._doc: The Territory: what a mercenary captain on the road actually sells you. A person, not a beast — the only humanoid in the pet list, because the others are all something a class summons.
